gaps.name: AE Coding Heterogeneity: text_pt vs MedDRA
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (2274 text_pt terms, 165 MedDRA codes — no cross-mapping)
gaps.impact: No MedDRA dictionary in KG. Fuzzy string matching can partially resolve.
gaps.closes_gap: Map text_pt terms to MedDRA preferred terms via fuzzy matching on the 165 known MedDRA-coded terms. Mint ae_coding_map edges.

gaps.name: Survival Time Column Absent from 13/13 AE Trials
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (0/13 AE trials have time-to-event column; 2 have event flag only)
gaps.impact: Survival time columns exist in source SAS tables under sponsor-specific names (e.g., SURVTIME, OSDAYS, AVAL) not captured by Session 3 extraction.
gaps.closes_gap: Re-extract survival time columns from SAS tables: search for AVAL, SURVTIME, OSDAYS, PFSDUR in adam tables. Requires live SAS CAS re-extraction.

gaps.name: TreatmentArm Nodes Missing Drug Name, Dose, Mechanism
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (36/36 arms have no drug name)
gaps.impact: Drug names are in SAS table columns (TRT, ATRT, TRTCD) not extracted into KG entity attributes.
gaps.closes_gap: Re-parse SAS extraction JSONs: extract TRT/ATRT column values per arm. Map arm_code → drug name. Update TreatmentArm nodes.

gaps.name: Serial Lab Data (118K+ rows) Not Ingested into KG
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (lab.sas7bdat present in SAS extraction but not in KG)
gaps.impact: Lab table columns not extracted in Session 3 ELT. SAS extraction JSONs contain table metadata but not row-level lab values.
gaps.closes_gap: Extract lab table rows from SAS extraction JSONs. Mint LabResult nodes per patient per timepoint. Link to TrialPatient via has_lab_result edges.

gaps.name: Drug Exposure/Dose Data (85K+ rows) Not Ingested
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (exposure.sas7bdat present but not in KG)
gaps.impact: Exposure table not extracted in Session 3 ELT.
gaps.closes_gap: Extract exposure table: TRTDOSE, TRTFRQCD columns per patient per cycle. Mint DrugExposure nodes. Link to TrialPatient and AdverseEventTerm.

gaps.name: AE Onset Timing Absent from All 58,987 AE Edges
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (0/58987 AE edges have onset_day or cycle)
gaps.impact: AE onset day/cycle columns (AESTDY, AECYCL) not extracted from SAS AE tables.
gaps.closes_gap: Re-parse SAS AE tables: extract AESTDY (AE start day) per patient-AE pair. Add onset_day attribute to experienced_ae edges.

gaps.name: 69 Hollow Trials: Drug Names and Endpoints Unknown
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (69 trials with 0 patients — caslib extraction failure)
gaps.impact: SAS CAS caslibs had no loadable SAS table files at Session 3 extraction time. Requires live SAS CAS re-extraction with updated credentials.
gaps.closes_gap: Re-extract hollow trials from live SAS CAS. Requires SAS_CAS_PASSWORD credential. Largest blocks: Prostate (18), Breast (12), Colorectal (10).

gaps.name: MSK Biospecimen-to-Genomic Feature Links Incomplete
gaps.current_tier: PARTIAL (135 edges for 40 biospecimens, 31 genomic features)
gaps.impact: MSK SPECTRUM WGS MAF/CNA files not fully parsed into per-biospecimen mutation edges.
gaps.closes_gap: Parse MSK SPECTRUM MAF file (syn39607857) and CNA file (syn39607858) per biospecimen. Mint harbors_mutation edges for all somatic variants.

gaps.name: Cross-Endpoint AE Rate Comparison Blocked by Schema Mismatch
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (Synapse=0 AE fields, PDS=58,987 AE edges — no common schema)
gaps.impact: MSK SPECTRUM clinical protocol does not capture AE data in the Synapse schema.
gaps.closes_gap: Add AE capture module to MSK SPECTRUM Synapse schema. Map to MedDRA preferred terms. Requires IRB amendment.

gaps.name: Pharmacovigilance Disproportionality Analysis Not Yet Executed
gaps.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (58,987 AE edges available but ROR/PRR not computed)
gaps.impact: Analytical gap — data is present, computation not yet done.
gaps.closes_gap: Run ROR disproportionality analysis per AE term × arm. Flag ROR > 2.0 with Fisher's exact p < 0.05. Session 8 Worker 1 addresses this.
